landing.title: What can I help you with?
landing.subtitle: Talk to your local AI. Yggdrasil picks the right resources automatically.

explain.label: Explain a topic
explain.prompt: Explain what a mutex is in two short paragraphs.

code.label: Help me code
code.prompt: Help me write a clean Go function that retries an HTTP request with backoff.

plan.label: Plan something
plan.prompt: Help me outline a weekend trip itinerary in three short sections.

composer.attachHint: Attach a document, spreadsheet, PDF, or code file
composer.runOnAutomatic: Norn chooses the best available computer.
composer.modelHint: Which installed model answers this chat
composer.autoHint: Auto picks an installed model for each message
composer.autoPicks: Auto · picks a model for each message
composer.noModelAsk: No model installed yet — sending will ask before downloading.
composer.noModelDownload: No model installed yet — sending will download automatically.
composer.chooseRunOn: Choose Run on before sending (Settings → Run chats on).

auto.label: Auto
auto.hint: Yggdrasil decides: quick questions stay fast, big or data questions get more care.

fast.label: Fast
fast.hint: Answers in one go, without planning or a second pass.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.hint: Plans big requests, reads a page when looking things up, and fixes figures once.

thorough.label: Thorough
thorough.hint: Reads more pages, uses the largest model that fits, and checks figures twice.

memory.onHint: This chat uses what you asked Yggdrasil to remember. Click to keep memory out of this chat.
memory.offHint: Memory is off for this chat. Saved memories are not used here and are not deleted.
memory.disabledHint: Memory is off for all chats. Turn it on from the Memory page.

send.waitForFiles: Wait for the files to finish adding, then send.
send.chooseRunOn: Choose where to run this chat: Automatic or This computer.
send.downloadFailed: Could not download a model for this chat.
send.installFirst: Install a model first, then try again.
send.noReply: The model stopped before it could reply. Yggdrasil stopped it and cleaned up the failed process.
send.unreachable: Could not reach the local AI. Check Diagnostics for details.
send.generationFailed: Something went wrong while generating a response.
send.confirmDownload: Download “{{model}}” so chat can continue? You can change this under Settings → Download models.

attachments.unsupported: Yggdrasil can't read this type of file yet
attachments.tooLarge: Files can be up to 25 MB
attachments.addFailed: The file could not be added.
attachments.audioFailed: The audio could not be loaded.
attachments.imageFailed: The image could not be loaded.
attachments.videoFailed: The video could not be loaded.

status.verifying: Checking the figures against the sources…

tools.permissionReason: The assistant wants to use a local tool to continue.
tools.decideFailed: Could not record the tool permission choice.

notResponding.title: Yggdrasil isn't responding
notResponding.body: The local service stopped answering. If this is the desktop app, quit and reopen it, then try again.

engineMissing.title: The AI engine isn't installed yet
engineMissing.body: Install it from Models, then send your message again.

noModel.title: No model is ready
noModel.body: Install or choose a model, then try again.

tooLong.title: This conversation is too long for the model
tooLong.body: Start a new chat, or choose a model that can hold more text.

outOfMemory.title: Not enough memory for this model
outOfMemory.body: Close other apps or choose a smaller model, then try again.

offline.title: A computer you're using is offline
offline.body: Turn it on and open Yggdrasil there, or run this chat on this computer.

connection.title: Couldn't reach the model
connection.body: The model stopped responding. This is usually temporary.

serverError.title: The model ran into a problem
serverError.body: Try again. If it keeps happening, try another model.

generic.title: Something went wrong
generic.body: Yggdrasil could not finish that reply. Try again in a moment.

readAloud.hint: Read this answer aloud on this computer
readAloud.busy: Reading aloud… (the first time downloads a voice)
readAloud.failed: It could not be read aloud.

context.title: Context
context.summarized_one: The oldest message was sent as a summary so the conversation fits. Every message is still saved.
context.summarized_other: The {{count}} oldest messages were sent as a summary so the conversation fits. Every message is still saved.
context.empty: Send a message to see how much of this model’s memory the chat is using.

run.gone: This run is no longer recorded.

notices.languageWeak: {{model}} may write {{language}} less well than English, and no installed model that fits writes it better. Models rated good in {{language}} are on the Models page.
